To play Wandering Towers for the first time, setup is simple: arrange the circular board, place the 9 movement towers on their designated spots, and position your wizards on top of them.
On your turn, play card actions from your hand to either move your wizards toward Ravenskeep or move entire towers (with wizards on them!) forward. Move towers over other wizards to trap them inside, which fills your empty potion bottles. Your goal is to fill all your potion bottles and get all your wizards into Ravenskeep first!
